answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each participant to stake a unique astrometric anchor tied to a verifiable voyage through a shared reference frame, so duplicate identities collapse onto one trajectory. Colluding nodes must then reconcile their claimed positions against a mirror of the ledger's parallax history, flagging any fabricated drift as river. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
